Dave Matthews Band
November 6, 2021
Van Andel Arena - Grand Rapids, MI

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > Zoom F6 (32 Bit Float)
Location: Back of FOH, DFC, on floor approx. between Sec. 106 & 125, Mics DIN @ 12'.
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.40 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.1.0 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)
